name: BC Replenishment Policy Advisor
brief: Recommend a Business Central reordering policy from the demand pattern, with safety stock, EOQ and reorder point in view.
description: Adds Item Card + Item List actions that show the three planning numbers (safety stock, reorder point, order quantity / EOQ) together, classify each item's demand pattern from posted sales, and recommend Fixed Reorder Qty., Maximum Qty., Lot-for-Lot, or Order for make-to-order. Optional auto-update of the item reordering policy and a Job Queue for scheduled bulk advice. MIT licensed, free, open source.
